verdict.rationale: Highnote's spend-rules and velocity-controls docs let developers restrict authorizations by exact dollar amount, MCC (merchant), and authorization count (enabling single-use enforcement), and agentic-commerce docs describe cards that auto-close after one workflow use — directly matching the 'one purchase, one merchant, exact amount' story. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation using 'single-use card' terminology and independent/hands-on verification that a leaked single-use card number is rejected after first use.
